name: Serra's Realm
description: An artificial plane Serra created, where she and her followers lived in peace defended by flights of angels.

timeline.summary: Jace begs Tamiyo to read the iron scroll about Serra's realm; she refuses to open it.
timeline.quote: No, Jace. The scroll stays closed.

timeline.summary: Serra creates the artificial plane Serra's Realm, where she and her followers live in peace defended by angels.
timeline.quote: She created an artificial plane known as Serra's Realm, where she and her followers lived in peace defended by flights of angels.

pages_say.description: A lost place whose cataclysm and survivors are told in one of Tamiyo's iron-bound scrolls.
The realm from which Lyra and other angels came.
The artifact powering the Weatherlight that Tiana may deliver to the Church.
